brief_title: A Phase Ⅲ Clinical Study of Combined Cisplatin Versus Placebo Combined With Intracavitary Cisplatin Injection in the Treatment of Malignant Pleural Effusions
why_rechecked: first trace of low confidence; result in doubt
first_trace_which_endpoint: PuFS (registry primary) and OS (dual primary per abstract)
first_trace_search_notes: COREMAP (Simcere, Endostar plus intracavitary cisplatin). Only result found is ESMO GI 2026 abstract 673P (Ann Oncol suppl, doi 10.1016/j.annonc.2026.05.202), titled final analysis, cutoff 10 Feb 2025: dual primary endpoints OS and PuFS; 'no statistically significant difference in PuFS'; OS median 7.8 vs 5.6 mo, HR 0.807 (0.625-1.042), Peto P=0.0338, called 'clinically meaningful', with no statement that OS met its significance boundary. HR CELLS ARE FOR OS, NOT PuFS (no PuFS HR given). On the registry's single primary endpoint (PuFS) this is not_met; coded unclear because the abstract names OS as a second primary and hints at success without stating it. Date is the Crossref deposit date; the congress was in early July 2026 (not verified), so the true date is probably about two weeks earlier. Simcere's 2025 annual results (25 Mar 2026) and 2026 interim results say only that the NDA for thoracoabdominal effusions was accepted in Feb 2026, with no result; 2024 annual results give last patient in Nov 2024. An earlier Chinese-language disclosure is possible.
